content: स्वास्थ्यम् .²1 Self-reliance, self-dependence. .²2 Fortitude, resoluteness, firmness; स्वास्थ्यं भद्र भजस्वार्य त्यज्यतां कृपणा मतिः <ls>Rām. 4. 1. 120</ls>. .²3 Sound state, health. .²4 Prosperity, well-being, comfortableness. .²5 Ease, satisfaction, spirits; लब्धं मया स्वास्थ्यम् <ls>Ś. 4</ls>.
